svg.data-cooling: fanless; the rack must supply at least 1 m/s of airflow in any direction without recirculation (HIG Cooling), and 43.5 mm of clear space is required above and below the unit when the ambient is between 45 and 65 C
svg.data-optics-sfp: 1G SFP SX/LX/EX/ZX, up to 70 km (datasheet Compatible Transceivers; HIG Port Overview gives 100M/1G on ports 0-7)
svg.data-optics-sfp-plus: 10G SFP+ SR/LR/ER/ZR, up to 80 km (datasheet Compatible Transceivers; HIG Port Overview gives 1/10G on ports 8-11)
svg.data-timing: Stratum 3E OCXO; SyncE; IEEE 1588v2 (default, G.8265.1, G.8275.1, G.8275.2, SMPTE ST 2059-2, T-BC/OC, T-TC) - NOS integration required to activate, and SMPTE ST 2059-2 needs an additional licence (the vendor's own footnotes)
svg.data-timing-inputs: 1x 1PPS in/out SMB, 1x 10MHz in/out SMB, 1x ToD in/out RJ45
svg.data-emc: FCC Part 15 Subpart B Class A; ICES-003 Class A; EN 55032 Class A; EN 55035; EN 300 386; VCCI CISPR 32 Class A; SANS 2332 Class A; SANS 2335; BSMI

rect.data-members: pps mhz mgmt usb tod console

g.data-description: the two FIXED 1+1 120W supplies. These do not pull out - what the front panel carries is each supply's input connector, drawn as a placement for that reason. Only the DC build is drawn; see gaps.
g.title: psu-0

g.data-description: the two FIXED 1+1 120W supplies. These do not pull out - what the front panel carries is each supply's input connector, drawn as a placement for that reason. Only the DC build is drawn; see gaps.
g.title: psu-1

g.data-description: 1PPS input/output, 50 ohm SMB with a 10-32UNF-2A connector; HIG Connecting the 1PPS Interface - cable no longer than 3 m
g.title: pps

g.data-description: 10MHz input/output, 50 ohm SMB; HIG Connecting the 10MHz Interface - cable no longer than 3 m
g.title: mhz

g.data-description: HIG SYNC row - Off (timing synchronization disabled or free-run), Solid Green (timing core, 1588 and SyncE, synchronized to an external source), Blinking Green (synchronized in SyncE mode), Solid Yellow (acquiring state or holdover), Blinking Yellow (synchronization fail). The table footnotes every row except holdover with 'need NOS to activate this feature'
g.title: led-sync

g.data-description: HIG STAT row - Off (system X86 and BMC initializing or not powered), Solid Green (system boot complete, NOS required to activate), Blinking Green (system is booting)
g.title: led-stat

g.data-description: HIG PSU row - Solid Green (both PSU feeds power good), Solid Yellow (PSU1 good, PSU2 not good), Blinking Yellow (PSU1 not good, PSU2 good), Off (the table says Reserved, so the dark state carries no meaning the vendor states)
g.title: led-psu

g.data-description: HIG PWR row - Off (system X86 and BMC initializing or not powered), Solid Green (system power good and CPU board power good), Blinking Green (system power fail, CPU board power good), Solid Yellow (system power good, CPU board power fail), Blinking Yellow (both fail)
g.title: led-pwr

g.data-description: the OOB management jack; its two integrated lamps (left green for 1G link and activity, right amber for 10M/100M, per the HIG Management port LED table) are drawn as led-a/led-b of this jack
g.title: mgmt

g.data-description: USB 2.0 Type-A; the HIG calls it a maintenance port
g.title: usb

g.data-description: ToD input/output, port marked TOD; HIG Connecting a Cable to the ToD Interface - a straight-through shielded Ethernet cable to a GNSS unit, no longer than 3 m
g.title: tod
